title: Hussain hote hai
body:
dilon ki ghair hai haalat kaho khuda hafiz
luta ke ashkon ki daulat kaho khuda hafiz
hai aaj roz e qayamat kaho khuda hafiz
bujhi hai shamme imamat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat kaho khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
musafiron ka moharram manalo ahle aza
jo aag dil mein lagi hai bujhalo ahle aza
tum apni aankhon mein aansu sajalo ahle aza
hai ek raat ki zehmat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sayyeda se hai waada usay wafa kar do
aza e sipte payambar par dil fida kar do
gham e hussain manane ka haq ada kar do
nahi to hogi shikayat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
baha ke ashk dil e fatema ko shaad karo
dil e rasool ki poori har ek muraad karo
laga tha seena e akbar pa zakhm yaad karo
milegi qalb ko raahat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
alam utha ke alamdar ko karo ruqsat
zameen pa baith kar beemar ko karo ruqsat
saron ko peet kar sardar ko karo ruqsat
bana ke nanhi si turbat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajao nanha sa taboot sheh ke asghar ka
alam uthao padho marsiya bahattar ka
saron pe taaziya rakho nabi ke dilbar ka
yehi hai ajre risalat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
udao khaak saron par hussain jaate hai
lutao ashkon ke gauhar hussain jaate hai
hamare ghar se bahattar hussain jaate hai
baha ke ashk e nidamat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
aza e shaah ki raunaq jo ghar se jayegi
alam ki yaad hamein saal bhar satayegi
uthega taaziya ghar se to saat jayegi
imambadon ki zeenat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha charaagh to tareek ye zamana hua
udaas udaas mere ghar ka aashiana hua
rasool zada suye karbala rawana hua
rasool e paak ki ummat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadayein aati hai reh reh ke saare aalam se
sukoon milta hai dil ko hussain ke gham se
magar hussain ki khidmat na ho saki hum se
dilon mein reh gayi hasrat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
raza na haath se choote hussain ka daaman
sada barasta rahe aansuon ka ye saawan
aza e sheh se mehekta raha mera gulshan
na kam ho sheh ki mohabbat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi
